_note: Full export of all mr_* reference tables prior to the provenance rebuild. Source of truth for values; the live DB is NOT backed up (Supabase free tier).
_mr_region_aliases_WARNING: DORMANT AND WRONG. Nothing in the code fetches this table. Several aliases collapse whole subcontinents onto one AR6 region: 'Sub-Saharan Africa'->WAF (West Africa only), 'Middle East & North Africa'->ARP (Arabian Peninsula only), 'Australia & Pacific'->EAU (Eastern Australia only). If wired, a client in Johannesburg would receive West Africa's hazard profile. DO NOT WIRE. Replace with a country-level mr_countries table.
_mr_region_hazards_NOTE: 65 of a possible 160 cells (20 regions x 8 hazards). ALL rows carry source_note='AR6 WGI starter' - i.e. these are STARTER VALUES, not transcriptions from AR6 WGI Ch12. A MISSING row currently renders as 'not assessed' (post-2026-07-14 fix) - previously it was silently DELETED from the report. Known gaps that do not make sense: ARP has no cyclone row (the Arabian Peninsula does get tropical cyclones - Gonu, Mekunu, Shaheen); ESAF has no flood and no cyclone row (Mozambique; Cyclone Idai).
_mr_industry_hazards_NOTE: 41 of a possible 104 cells (13 sectors x 8 hazards). No provenance column. Per the methodology doc s4.4 these are 'starter values'. Per the ECB, assigning sector sensitivity scores by expert judgment IS the prescribed method - no public, non-proprietary sector x hazard matrix exists (everyone who has one sells it). The fix is to DISCLOSE the judgment, not to source it.
